# Box SDK for Apex — endpoint reference

One page per endpoint, grouped by resource manager. Reach every
endpoint through the single `Box` client. Apex needs no `import`
statements — every generated class is visible in the namespace.

```apex
Box client = new Box(myBoxClient);
```
